info.title: Hello management API
info.description: hello-control REST API. Every route except version, openapi.json and auth/login requires the hello_session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Secrets (device SIP secrets, API tokens, trunk passwords) appear only in the response that creates them; trunk passwords never appear in any response.

get.summary: Build and configuration revision of this control-plane node
get.description: Returns the build version, commit and current configuration revision of the hello-control node that answered. Use it to check which release is running or whether the configuration changed.
Returns this OpenAPI document, which describes every /api/v1 operation.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: the document itself; tools are generated from it

post.summary: Start a session; sets the hello_session cookie
post.description: Starts a browser session for a username and password and sets the hello_session cookie. Used by the console; API clients use bearer tokens instead.

Set-Cookie.description: hello_session=<value>; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Secure when the request is HTTPS

403.description: A cross-origin browser request, refused before the credentials are read (plain text)

x-hello-mcp.exclude: starts a browser session

post.summary: End the current session and clear the cookie
post.description: Ends the current session and clears the hello_session cookie.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: ends a browser session

get.description: Returns the authenticated user. Use it to check who the credentials belong to.
Lists the current user's API tokens (names, creation and last use; never the token values).

x-hello-mcp.exclude: credential management stays in the console

post.summary: Create an API token; the token is returned only in this response
post.description: Creates an API token for the current user. The token value is returned only in this response and only its SHA-256 is stored.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: credential management stays in the console

delete.description: Revokes one of the current user's API tokens; requests with it fail from then on.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: credential management stays in the console

get.description: Lists every extension, ordered by number. Use it to find an extension's id from its number before reading or changing it.

post.summary: Create an extension
post.description: Creates an extension (a dialable number with a name). Devices, voicemail and routes then refer to it by id. A 400 lists each failing field (number, name, externalNumber) in error.fields.

get.description: Returns one extension by id.

patch.summary: Change an extension's number or name
patch.description: Changes an extension's number, name or external caller ID; only the fields sent change. Changing the number is 409 while a route refers to it (inbound destination or outbound source extension) (the message names the routes). Changes are checked as a whole routing configuration; a 400 lists failing fields. A 400 lists each failing field (number, name, externalNumber) in error.fields.

delete.summary: Delete an extension and its devices
delete.description: Deletes an extension together with its devices. 409 while a route refers to the extension (an inbound route rings it, or an outbound route is restricted to it as a source); the message names the routes.

get.summary: Every device, ordered by SIP username
get.description: Lists every device (SIP account), ordered by SIP username; secrets are never included.

post.summary: Create a device; its SIP secret is returned only in this response
post.description: Creates a device (a SIP account) on an extension. Its SIP secret is generated and returned only in this response.

get.description: Returns one device by id, without its secret.

patch.summary: Enable, disable or move a device
patch.description: Enables, disables or moves a device to another extension.

delete.description: Deletes a device; phones registered with it can no longer register.

post.summary: Replace a device's SIP secret; the new secret is returned only in this response
post.description: Replaces a device's SIP secret. The new secret is returned only in this response, and the phone must be reconfigured with it.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: secrets-scoped: the new secret is shown only in the console

get.summary: Every registered contact binding in the cluster (from Valkey)
get.description: Lists every registered SIP contact binding in the cluster, from the live state. Use it to see which devices are online and where.

get.summary: Every active call in the cluster (from Valkey)
get.description: Lists every call in progress in the cluster, from the live state.
Lists call detail records, newest first, one page at a time, with optional filters. Use it to look at call history.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return CDRs with an id below this one (the previous page's next)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-200.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Keep only calls of this direction

parameters.name: failed
parameters.description: true keeps only failed calls (final status outside 2xx)

get.summary: How many call records exist, and how many failed
get.description: Counts call records, in total and failed, for the same filters as the list. Use it for summaries without paging.

get.summary: Recorded calls in progress over a time window, by direction
get.description: Returns how many calls were up at once over a time window, in buckets. Use it to size trunks or spot busy hours. Samples, at every step of the window, how many CDRs were in progress (start <= t < end). Calls still in progress have no CDR yet and are not counted; GET /api/v1/calls lists those.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Window ending at the last whole step: 1h in 5 min steps, 6h in 15 min steps, 24h in 1 h steps

get.summary: Call detail records as CSV, newest first
get.description: Exports the filtered call records as a CSV download. The CDRs matching the filters, at most 10000 rows. A cell a spreadsheet would evaluate as a formula gets a leading apostrophe.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Keep only calls of this direction

parameters.name: failed
parameters.description: true keeps only failed calls (final status outside 2xx)

x-hello-mcp.exclude: CSV download

get.summary: One CDR with its routing trace and failure explanation
get.description: Returns one call record with its routing trace and, for a failed call, an explanation. Use it to troubleshoot why a call went where it did.
Lists every SIP trunk; passwords are never included.

post.summary: Create a trunk
post.description: Creates a SIP trunk to a carrier, by registration or by IP. The password is sealed and never returned. Validated field by field, then as a whole configuration with the routing engine; a 400 lists every failing field in error.fields.

get.summary: Live registration, destination health and active calls of every trunk
get.description: Returns each trunk's live health. Use it to troubleshoot calls over trunks. 503 while Valkey is unreachable.
Returns one trunk by id; its password is never included.

patch.description: Changes a trunk; only the fields sent change. Validated field by field, then as a whole configuration with the routing engine; a 400 lists every failing field in error.fields. Destinations and sourceCidrs, when given, replace the lists.

delete.description: Deletes a trunk. 409 while an inbound or outbound route names the trunk; the message names the routes.

get.summary: Every outbound route in position order
get.description: Lists every outbound route in the order they are tried. Use it before adding or reordering routes.

post.summary: Append an outbound route
post.description: Creates an outbound route that sends matching dialled numbers to trunks. It is added last in the order. Validated field by field, then as a whole configuration with the routing engine; a 400 lists every failing field in error.fields.

put.summary: Reorder every outbound route at once
put.description: Sets the order outbound routes are tried in; the body lists every route id once. ids must be a full permutation; the order changes atomically.

get.description: Returns one outbound route by id.

patch.description: Changes an outbound route; only the fields sent change. Validated field by field, then as a whole configuration with the routing engine; a 400 lists every failing field in error.fields.

delete.description: Deletes an outbound route; numbers it matched fall through to the next route.

get.summary: Every inbound route in position order
get.description: Lists every inbound route in the order they are tried. Use it before adding or reordering routes.

post.summary: Append an inbound route
post.description: Creates an inbound route that sends calls arriving from trunks (by DID, trunk, domain or header) to an extension, external number or SIP URI. It is added last in the order. Validated field by field, then as a whole configuration with the routing engine; a 400 lists every failing field in error.fields.

put.summary: Reorder every inbound route at once
put.description: Sets the order inbound routes are tried in; the body lists every route id once. ids must be a full permutation; the order changes atomically.

get.description: Returns one inbound route by id.

patch.description: Changes an inbound route; only the fields sent change. Validated field by field, then as a whole configuration with the routing engine; a 400 lists every failing field in error.fields.

delete.description: Deletes an inbound route; calls it matched fall through to the next route.

post.summary: Decide a call against the saved configuration without placing it
post.description: Simulates routing a call through the current configuration without placing it, and returns the decision and its trace. Use it to check a route change before relying on it. Writes nothing. Trunk usability comes from live state; when Valkey is unreachable every enabled trunk counts as usable and the trace says so. Trunk capacity (maxCalls) is not judged from cached counts: hello-sip decides it when the call is placed, and the trace says so for every candidate trunk with a limit.

get.summary: Cluster members, dependency health and configuration revision
get.description: Returns the cluster overview. Answers 200 with a dependency down, reporting it: members are empty while Valkey is unreachable, and the revision and lags are absent while PostgreSQL is.
Lists every cluster member, live and offline, with its state.

post.summary: Ask a node to drain
post.description: Asks a cluster member to drain. Use it before maintenance. Writes a drain request the node acts on within 5s, and audits it (actor and node; action drain, or drain-force when forced). 409 when draining would leave no READY SIP node, counting nodes with a pending drain request as not READY (repeat with ?force=true), or when the node is OFFLINE.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The node's HELLO_NODE_ID

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Drain even if no READY SIP node would remain

delete.description: Cancels a drain so the member takes new calls again. Withdraws the drain request and audits it (action undrain). The node is not looked up, so a request for a node whose record has expired can still be withdrawn. 409 when no drain request exists (e.g. a node draining from SIGTERM). A node that has started exiting still exits.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The node's HELLO_NODE_ID

get.description: Returns an extension's voicemail box settings; the PIN is never returned. The box is created with the extension; a missing box (an extension that predates it) is 404.

put.description: Changes an extension's voicemail box: PIN, notification email and, through the multipart form, greetings. JSON with password and/or email, or multipart/form-data with the same fields plus optional `greeting` and `unreachable` WAV files (PCM, 5 MiB max); greetings land in the hello-voicemail bucket and the previous object is removed. At least one field is required. The password is stored as a hash and never returned.

requestBody.description: Either form changes the box; at least one field is required.

password.description: New voicemail PIN; stored as a hash.

email.description: Address new messages are mailed to; empty disables voicemail email.

greeting.description: The busy/no-answer greeting, a PCM WAV of at most 5 MiB.

unreachable.description: The greeting played when the extension is unreachable, a PCM WAV of at most 5 MiB.

get.description: Lists every voicemail box with its message counts. One row per box: the extension's number and name and its unheard and total messages, so a box list needs one request.

200.description: Every box with its extension and message counts, by extension number

get.description: Lists voicemail messages, newest first, optionally for one extension. `box` is a voicemail box id (required); `unheard=true` keeps the messages not played yet.

post.summary: Mark a voicemail message heard
post.description: Marks a voicemail message heard, or unheard again. An empty body marks heard; a body of `{"heard": false}` marks it unheard again.

get.description: Streams a voicemail message's audio (WAV, Range supported). The message audio, streamed through hello-control (the object store is not reachable from the browser); Range requests answer 206. The message must exist before the store is touched: a missing message is 404.

200.description: The audio, streamed through hello-control with Content-Length, Accept-Ranges: bytes and Cache-Control: private

206.description: The requested byte range of the audio (Range request)

x-hello-mcp.exclude: binary audio response

delete.description: Deletes a voicemail message and its audio. Removes the row and the audio object in the hello-voicemail bucket.

get.description: Lists call recordings, newest first, one page at a time.

parameters.name: extension
parameters.description: Keep only recordings of calls this extension was on (joined through the CDRs).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Page cursor: recordings with a lower id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-200.

200.description: Recordings, newest first, with the cursor for the next page

delete.description: Deletes a call recording and its audio. Removes the row and the audio object in the hello-recordings bucket.

get.description: Streams a call recording's audio (WAV, Range supported). The recording audio, streamed through hello-control (the object store is not reachable from the browser); Range requests answer 206. The recording must exist before the store is touched: a missing recording is 404.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: true or 1 sends the audio as an attachment named recording-<id>.wav (Content-Disposition), so the browser saves it instead of playing it.

200.description: The audio, streamed through hello-control with Content-Length, Accept-Ranges: bytes and Cache-Control: private

206.description: The requested byte range of the audio (Range request)

x-hello-mcp.exclude: binary audio response

get.description: Lists the uploaded announcements that ring groups and routes can play.

post.summary: Upload an announcement
post.description: Uploads an announcement (a WAV file and a name). Stores the WAV in the hello-announcements bucket under ann/<name>.wav.

name.description: Unique name the announcement is configured by.

file.description: WAV bytes, at most 10 MiB; the bytes are checked, not the declared content type.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: multipart file upload

put.description: Replaces an announcement's name or audio. Overwrites the audio at ann/<name>.wav in the hello-announcements bucket, validated like the upload, then moves updatedAt; audited, bumps the configuration revision and notifies hello-sip.

name.description: Optional; must equal the announcement's name, which cannot change.

file.description: WAV bytes, at most 10 MiB; the bytes are checked, not the declared content type.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: multipart file upload

delete.description: Deletes an announcement and its audio. Removes the row and the audio object in the hello-announcements bucket; destinations that named it skip the step at call time.

get.description: Streams an announcement's audio (WAV, Range supported). The announcement audio, streamed through hello-control (the object store is not reachable from the browser); Range requests answer 206. A missing announcement is 404.

200.description: The audio, streamed through hello-control with Content-Length, Accept-Ranges: bytes and Cache-Control: private

206.description: The requested byte range of the audio (Range request)

x-hello-mcp.exclude: binary audio response

get.description: Lists every ring or hunt group with its members.

200.description: Groups with their members in position order

post.summary: Create a ring/hunt group
post.description: Creates a ring or hunt group: a number of extensions rung together or in turn, with what happens when nobody answers. Validation failures list each failing field (strategy, failureKind, members' positions, weights) in error.fields.

get.description: Returns one ring or hunt group by id.

patch.description: Changes a ring or hunt group; only the fields sent change. Absent fields keep their value; a members list replaces the whole member list. The result is validated as a whole before it is stored.

delete.description: Deletes a ring or hunt group. The members go with it.

get.description: Lists the DTMF feature codes (star codes) and the actions they trigger.

put.description: Replaces the whole feature-code configuration. The list is the complete configuration: every item is upserted and every code not in the list is removed. Codes are '*' plus 2-4 digits, or '##'; actions are forward_always, forward_busy, forward_no_answer, dnd_on, dnd_off, voicemail, blind_transfer, attended_transfer.

get.description: Lists every device's live presence state. The dialog state hello-sip publishes per device: idle, ringing, on-call or dnd.

get.summary: Why a device is or is not registered
get.description: Returns one device's registration diagnostics. Use it to troubleshoot a phone that does not register. The device's current bindings, its recent REGISTER attempts (newest first; hello-sip keeps the last 20 per enabled device for 1 h after the latest) and the failed-auth counter of the last attempt's source IP. verdict explains a missing registration from those facts only, and is null while the device is registered. 503 while live state (Valkey) is unavailable.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Device id

get.description: Lists source addresses with recent SIP authentication failures. Every source IP with a failed-auth counter in its current window (HELLO_SIP_AUTH_FAIL_WINDOW). blocked is true at or above limit (HELLO_SIP_AUTH_FAIL_LIMIT as hello-control reads it): hello-sip then answers that IP 403 until the window ends.

delete.description: Clears the authentication failures recorded for one source address. Deletes the source's failed-auth counter, so it is no longer throttled. 404 when ip is not an IP address.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address

get.summary: Every provisioned phone, ordered by MAC
get.description: Lists every provisioned phone, ordered by MAC address.

post.summary: Add a phone; binding an existing device rotates its secret. The provisioning URL with the token is returned only here
post.description: Adds a phone for auto-provisioning, bound to an extension. The provisioning URL with its token is returned only in this response.

post.summary: Import phones from CSV (mac,vendor,model,extension[,label][,blf]); dryRun=true only checks. An apply creates every row in one transaction or none (400 with the rows)
post.description: Checks or creates phones from a CSV body.

400.description: A malformed request (an error), or an apply with failing rows (the result, ok false, nothing created)

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: true only checks the rows; false (the default) creates them all or none.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: text/csv request body; tools send JSON

get.description: Returns one provisioned phone by id.

patch.summary: Change a phone; deviceId null unbinds (and disables) it, a new deviceId or extensionId rebinds it and rotates that device's secret
patch.description: Changes a provisioned phone; only the fields sent change.

delete.summary: Delete a phone; its device stays without the sealed secret
delete.description: Deletes a provisioned phone; its device stays.

post.summary: New provisioning token; the old one stays valid for the grace period unless immediate=true. The URL is returned only here
post.description: Issues a new provisioning token for a phone. The URL with the token is returned only in this response.

parameters.name: immediate
parameters.description: true invalidates the old token at once instead of after the grace period.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: secrets-scoped: the provisioning URL is shown only in the console

post.summary: Rotate the token at once and arm the phone for one more DHCP boot hand-off
post.description: Rotates a phone's provisioning token at once and arms it for one more boot hand-off. The URL is returned only in this response.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: secrets-scoped: the provisioning URL is shown only in the console

post.summary: Return the phone's web UI admin password; audited
post.description: Returns a phone's web UI admin password. Every reveal is audited.

adminPassword.description: The phone's web UI admin password.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: secrets-scoped: the password is shown only in the console

post.summary: Set a new random admin password; the phone takes it at its next fetch
post.description: Sets a new random web UI admin password for a phone; the phone takes it at its next fetch.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: secrets-scoped

get.summary: The phone's provisioning fetches, newest first
get.description: Lists a phone's provisioning fetches, newest first, one page at a time. Use it to see whether and when a phone picked up its configuration.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Page cursor: fetches with a lower id (the previous page's next).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-200.

get.summary: Render a file as the phone would get it, with the SIP secret, admin password and token masked; not a fetch
get.description: Renders one provisioning file as the phone would get it, with secrets masked, without counting as a fetch. Use it to check a template change.

422.description: The template fails to render for this phone (code render_error)

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The file name the phone would request, such as its MAC-named configuration file.

get.description: Lists the built-in and stored provisioning templates.

post.summary: Create a template
post.description: Creates a stored provisioning template.

post.summary: Validate a template without saving it
post.description: Checks that a template parses and renders, without saving it.

get.description: Returns one provisioning template by id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A stored template's id, or a built-in's builtinRef

patch.summary: Change a stored template; the previous version is kept
patch.description: Changes a stored provisioning template; the previous version is kept.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A stored template's id, or a built-in's builtinRef

delete.summary: Delete a stored template; refused while a phone overrides with it

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A stored template's id, or a built-in's builtinRef

post.summary: Copy a template (built-in or stored) to edit, one priority higher
post.description: Copies a template, built-in or stored, into a new stored one to edit.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A stored template's id, or a built-in's builtinRef

get.description: Lists the uploaded firmware files.

post.summary: Upload a firmware file (up to 512 MiB); the fields vendor, modelGlob, version (and optional filename) precede the file part
post.description: Uploads a firmware file for phones to fetch.

vendor.description: Phone vendor the firmware is for.

modelGlob.description: Shell-style glob of the models it is for.

version.description: The firmware version string, as the phone reports it.

filename.description: File name the phone fetches; defaults to the uploaded file's name.

file.description: The firmware image, up to 512 MiB; must be the last part.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: multipart file upload

delete.summary: Delete a firmware file; refused while pinned

get.description: Lists the vendor redirect-service accounts used to point new phones at Hello; credentials are never returned.

put.summary: Set a vendor's account; credentials are checked with the vendor, sealed and never returned. Accounts set by the deployment are read-only

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: The phone vendor whose redirect-service account to act on.

delete.description: Removes a vendor's stored redirect-service account.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: The phone vendor whose redirect-service account to act on.

post.summary: Test the vendor's effective credentials
post.description: Checks the vendor's effective redirect-service credentials against the vendor and records the result.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: The phone vendor whose redirect-service account to check.

get.summary: Computed provisioning URLs, CA fingerprint and DHCP option values
get.description: Returns the computed provisioning settings: URLs, CA fingerprint and DHCP option values. Use it to configure DHCP for phones.

Returns whether external AI access is enabled (HELLO_PUBLIC_URL), the MCP and API resource URLs, their metadata URLs, the MCP protocol versions, whether dynamic client registration is on, and what each scope allows.

Returns what the consent screen shows for a pending authorization request: the client, its host, the requested scopes and resources, and the scopes the caller's role may grant. Answers 404 when the request is unknown, expired or already decided, or external AI access is off.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The authorization request id from the consent redirect.

post.summary: Approve an authorization request
post.description: Approves a pending authorization request with the given scopes, which must be a subset of the requested ones and of the caller's role's grantable scopes, and returns the client redirect carrying a single-use code. Only a browser session may call it.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The authorization request id from the consent redirect.

200.description: The client redirect URI to send the browser to

redirect.description: The client's redirect URI with code (or error=access_denied), state and iss.

post.summary: Deny an authorization request
post.description: Refuses a pending authorization request and returns the client redirect carrying error=access_denied. Only a browser session may call it.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The authorization request id from the consent redirect.

200.description: The client redirect URI to send the browser to

redirect.description: The client's redirect URI with code (or error=access_denied), state and iss.

get.description: Lists the live OAuth grants (connected apps) of the caller; an admin sees every user's.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

delete.description: Revokes a grant and every token issued under it; the next request with any of them is refused. Users revoke their own grants, admins anyone's.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

get.description: Lists the service accounts with their role, scopes and live client secrets (metadata only; a secret is shown once, when created).

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

post.summary: Create a service account
post.description: Creates a service account for a headless agent: a name, a role, and the scopes it may hold, bounded by the role. It has no secret until one is created.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

get.description: Returns one service account.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The service account's client id (hello_sa_...).

patch.description: Changes a service account's description, role, scopes or enabled state. Changing the role, scopes or enabled state revokes its live tokens.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The service account's client id (hello_sa_...).

delete.description: Deletes a service account, its secrets and its tokens.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The service account's client id (hello_sa_...).

post.summary: Create a client secret
post.description: Creates a client secret for the service account and returns it once; only its SHA-256 is stored. An account holds at most two live secrets (409 for a third), so secrets can be rotated.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The service account's client id (hello_sa_...).

expiresAt.description: When the secret stops working; null or absent for never.

delete.description: Revokes a client secret and the account's live access tokens; the next request with them is refused.

x-hello-mcp.exclude: Credential management stays in the console: an agent never manages its own or other credentials.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The service account's client id (hello_sa_...).

parameters.name: secretId
parameters.description: The client secret's id.

id.name: id

FieldError.description: One failing field. For a single trunk, route or extension create/PATCH, paths are relative to that item and use its JSON field names, e.g. "match", "trunks[0]", "numberTransform.template", "schedule.timeZone", "destinations[1].host". An error the whole-configuration check finds in another item keeps its full path in the routing configuration, e.g. "outbound[3].numberTransform.template" or "trunks[1].destinations" (index = position in that list as loaded), and a reorder reports "ids" or "ids[i]". Only errors a change introduces reject it: errors the saved configuration already had (for example after a manual edit) do not block fixing, deleting or unrelated changes.
